summary: [P2] Remote administration service reachable from untrusted networks on Admin jump host (jump01.novarefino.example:3389)
steps: Remove the direct exposure: close the port on the perimeter firewall / security group for any source outside the admin allowlist.
Publish remote administration only through the corporate VPN or a zero-trust access broker with MFA.
Enforce Network Level Authentication (RDP) or key-only authentication (SSH) and disable password logins for privileged accounts.
Record the rule change with ticket ID in the firewall change log.
verify: From an external vantage point, nmap -Pn -p <port> <public IP> must report filtered/closed.
Confirm the service is still reachable through the VPN / broker path for authorised admins.

summary: [P3] SNMP v1/v2c with default or guessable community string on Core switch (core-sw01.corp.novarefino.example:161)
steps: Migrate the device to SNMPv3 with authPriv (SHA-2 + AES).
If v2c must stay temporarily, set a long random read-only community and an ACL that allows only the NMS address.
verify: NMS still polls the device over SNMPv3.
